EIP-155 signing preimage = `rlp([...fields, chainId, 0, 0])` (was missing chainId,0,0). - Verified: address matches ethers, tx recovers signer, low-s, byte-identical, deterministic, vault create/unlock/wrong-passphrase (failed attempt wipes session = defense-in-depth), no plaintext key in localStorage. - Added `chain.sessionKeyHex()` export (guarded, only when unlocked) for the MetaMask export flow. ## Page integration DONE (`art/index.html` + `_headers`) - `
